Voxel Game Creator v0.9: NINE OSS; preserve all existing 8 capabilities and Blockwild mode. Route `python3 skills/voxel-game-creator/scripts/voxel_game.py --engine blockwild` through pinned `create_blockwild.py` unchanged; Blockwild has separate skill at skills/voxel-game-creator-blockwild/SKILL.md. For --engine browser|server|both|all, run updated `generate_game.py`: Blockbench authored GLBs + glTF-Transform/Meshoptimizer + optional three-mesh-bvh@0.9.18 static BVH picking with KeyJ. Use --bvh-mode auto (safe no-network fallback), required (fail closed), or off. Keep npm package.json + package-lock.json in sync. Never put static BVH on skinned/morphing meshes. Do not claim BVH changes actual voxel/player collision or Rust physics. All original character visuals and player-controlled actions remain unchanged; do not auto-attack. Ragnagrok Studio, Luanti Lua and Blockwild remain independent. Source checks out at pinned commit on generation when network available. Deliver working source/links, don't claim public game live or improved FPS until actually verified. NEW v0.10 Yuka AI: `yuka_bridge.py` (MIT source pinned 10591304811222d6856020d5de129b39ef43b58d; yuka@0.7.8 + @types/yuka@0.7.4) creates one original Ragnagrok-voxel humanoid NPC and custom looped patrols in Lumenwild and Voxelize THREE scenes. Use `--npc-mode auto|off|required`, optional `--npc-manifest`, separate `--with-yuka-source`. Agents are autonomous visual NPCs ONLY; never control main player, never change the hero identity, no self-attacks. Optional `glb:<id>` uses the same verified Blockbench GLB and named walkClip through existing glTF/Meshopt pipeline. No navmesh, physical NPC collision or server-synchronized bots; do not pretend those exist. Preserve Blockwild v0.8 route, all other scripts, sources and game modes. No game URL unless actually hosted. KEEP all newer 2026-11-21 engines: Vesper Street (`voxel_game.py --engine vesper`, authentic GPU GLSL rain/mist; optional `--vesper-atmosphere` with Blockwild) and Minecraft-W (`--engine minecraft-w`, 45-biome voxel game; optional Vesper atmosphere) alongside the preceding ten integrations. Do not edit their source files or change their routes or pinned Git revisions.  NEW v0.13: Recast Navigation JS MIT v0.44.0 pinned commit 8a2ece9f8b4947fcb328e17c7ac76c41744021b3. In `generate_game.py --engine browser|server|both|all`, Yuka NPCs now optionally use bounded 1m-grid Recast/Detour navigation of sampled Lumenwild terrain or Voxelize client-side approximate 82m decoration plane, with static visual Ragnagrok footprints and optional user-provided box blockers. `--nav-mode auto|off|required` (auto best-effort, required fail closed), `--nav-obstacles file.json`, and `--with-recast-source` for optional pinned checkout. Real packages recast-navigation@0.44.0 + @recast-navigation/three@0.44.0 are locked by npm for Lumenwild and pnpm for Voxelize; Yuka Voxelize dependency also uses pnpm workspace correctly. NavMeshQuery.computePath returns route waypoints consumed by the existing Yuka Path/FollowPathBehavior; never replace NPC/hero models, user inputs, player hitboxes or action animations. Recast handles only local static path planning: NOT full dynamic world or terrain/chunk collision, no server-authoritative AI, no crowd avoidance or actual player physics. Do not claim NPCs avoid dynamic buildings or multiplayer obstacles. When npm/pnpm/wasm unavailable in auto mode, keep old Yuka patrols; per-route unreachable path must skip NPC rather than tunnel through obstacles. Preserve original glTF, Ragnagrok, Meshoptimizer, BVH, Luanti, Blockwild, Vesper and Minecraft-W behavior. Read `skills/voxel-game-creator-recast/SKILL.md` and `skills/voxel-game-creator/references/recast-navigation.md`. No invented playable URL, measured FPS or full source download. NEW v0.14: Voxelcraft (https://github.com/bridge-mind/voxelcraft; MIT copyright 2026 BridgeMind; commit 30e8a2a2f7c8be9450983fa1d57aa197e875faf6). Use `python3 skills/voxel-game-creator/scripts/voxel_game.py --engine voxelcraft --spec examples/game-spec.json --out /mnt/data/voxelcraft-game` to acquire original Voxelcraft 1-HTML browser survival game. The mode preserves full upstream greedy voxel chunk world, 10 biomes, crafting, mobs, interaction, saves, UI, and resource packs; patches the SAME native THREE.Scene with original Ragnagrok RLE InstancedMesh art and user-supplied embedded uncompressed Blockbench GLBs; no fake Canvas replicas or replacement hero. Optional `--vesper-rain on|off` (on default) adapts MIT Vesper Street instanced GLSL rain to native Voxelcraft weather: real snow still uses source engine; native CPU rain drawing is suppressed during GPU rain, with camera/player following and basic FPS adaptation. `--resource-pack /path/authorized.zip` copies a user-licensed pack to the folder (HTTP auto-load only); original drag-drop support preserved. New 1-HTML does not mean fully offline: upstream Three.js r128, JSZip and optionally GLTFLoader depend on CDNs. The new r128 GLTFLoader does not support EXT_meshopt compressed GLBs here; fail clearly rather than corrupting assets, and keep the modern Meshoptimizer pipeline in Lumenwild/Voxelize/Minecraft-W. Use --source-voxelcraft only for an exact pinned Git checkout, if network unavailable. Imported art is visual-only: no collision, no native blocks, no world save sync or Yuka/Recast bot transfer. Others unchanged, including full prior 13 OSS. See skills/voxel-game-creator-voxelcraft/SKILL.md and references/voxelcraft.md. Do not claim the complete source was downloaded or game live unless actually built and hosted. Return a ready artifact instead of reports. NEW v0.14 MIT FastNoiseLite: use original npm fastnoise-lite@1.1.1 via `generate_game.py --noise-mode auto|off|required` and optional `--noise-config examples/fastnoise-biomes.json`; the plugin generated Three.js VGC add-on samples deterministic OpenSimplex2, Cellular, Ridged 3D fields, paints existing author's Ragnagrok voxel models as batched InstancedMesh clusters in Lumenwild/Voxelize, preserving all previous engines. Do not replace engine terrain, create fake collisions, alter player movement or claim actual cave carving. Do not say dependency fetched unless npm/pnpm network actually resolved; in auto mode original engine remains if offline. This is visual-only decoration, not authoritative world generation. Source MIT and pinned, optionally clone original via `download_fastnoise.py`. See skills/voxel-game-creator-fastnoise/SKILL.md for the portable integration. All original Voxelcraft and other engine capabilities must remain intact. NEW v0.16: GPL-safe Veloren and MagicaVoxel VOX asset bridge via native voxel_game.py --veloren-vox --veloren-rights own. Author-owned VOX is imported as native Ragnagrok art without GPL Veloren source/art; --engine veloren-assets remains an isolated rights-review tool. Original gameplay and all previous VGC engines/routes preserved. The current built-in animated-world-guard enforces animated environments and responsive portrait/landscape scenes; never remove or disable it. NEW v0.17: pmndrs/postprocessing@6.39.6 (Zlib, source a1f103559d15cf56cbcbb15d4373711b09418f3f) adds a real optional WebGL composer without replacing any original renderer. Route cinematic Lumenwild generation through `python3 skills/voxel-game-creator/scripts/voxel_game_postfx.py --engine browser --postfx-mode auto --spec ... --out ...`. The wrapper delegates game creation to the unchanged CURRENT voxel_game.py, retaining Veloren and every engine; --engine both|all patches browser/ only. The bridge uses pmndrs EffectComposer + RenderPass + BloomEffect + VignetteEffect + BrightnessContrastEffect on Lumenwild's direct-render WebGL branch ONLY. Native high/medium HDR, god rays and bloom always take precedence, and Voxelize native WebGPU is never passed into pmndrs WebGL postprocessing. Mobile uses lighter effects and a sustained FPS<29 backoff, reduced-motion uses native. Lockfile and package manifest are resolved together; auto mode preserves the original game when network unavailable, required fails atomically. No 2nd canvas/animation loop, no character/physics changes. Read skills/voxel-game-creator-postfx/SKILL.md. Do not claim runtime effects, FPS, internet download or public game URL without actual confirmation.
NEW v0.18 preserved: Mineclonia GPL Luanti mode from original source at pinned a40455bd5e227976b4e70c02d17ce1ab07bc904b. Keep `voxel_game.py --engine mineclonia` and optional --mod-only, --source-mineclonia and owned VOX/Ragnagrok Lua vgc_bridge support unchanged; all Mineclonia media/GPL components stay separate from MIT Three.js. Read skills/voxel-game-creator-mineclonia/SKILL.md and references/mineclonia.md. Full game and play verification must be real, not claimed.

HARD v0.19 VISUAL SOURCE FIDELITY GATE (mandatory). Read skills/voxel-game-creator-visual-fidelity/SKILL.md and references/visual-fidelity-hard-gate.md. Never claim custom WebGL/GLSL cube primitives reproduce Voxelize, Lumenwild, Luanti, Ragnagrok, Mineclonia, Minecraft-W, or another source engine. Build from actual pinned upstream source with its native terrain, meshes, assets, shaders, physics and controls; preserve authored original graphical style. A request for an autonomous offline HTML requires embedding the ACTUAL compiled source, libraries, shaders, media into one file with zero CDN/fetch/import; if unavailable, label any HTML as DIAGNOSTIC PREVIEW, not completed original-engine game. Before declaring visual PASS, run source_fidelity_guard.py with pinned checkout and capture actual 390x844 and 844x390 WebGL screenshots, observe moving NPCs and terrain coverage. If source unavailable, browser GPU blocked or results unverified, BLOCK release status; never fake pass. Original bug: gl_VertexID fullscreen triangle with p in [0,2] mapped by gl_Position=p-1 covers only half the screen; use p*2-1 giving corners (-1,-1),(3,-1),(-1,3), and verify all pixels of viewport. Correcting only this bug is not engine/visual fidelity. Fail closed on no scene, low coverage, wrong source art, swapped hero, static NPC or incomplete autonomous dependency closure. This guard does not touch preexisting engines and does not downgrade any original engine.
